title: Historical Events Timeline
subject: History
topic: Timeline of events mentioned in the passage
caption: Timeline of key Indian historical milestones from ancient to modern era
altText: A chronological timeline showing eight events: Maurya Empire founded in 322 BCE, Ashoka's Edicts in 260 BCE, Patanjali's Mahabhashya in the 2nd century BCE, Gandhi's first major public appearance in 1916, the Self-Respect Movement launched in 1925, Indian independence in 1947, the Emergency declared in 1975, and economic liberalisation beginning in 1991.
